title: Morning Glory Muffins
ingredients:
1 ½ cups white flour
½ cup whole wheat flour
1 ¼ cups sugar
1 Tbsp cinnamon
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
½ tsp salt
1-2 cups grated carrots
1 apple peeled and chopped
1 cup raisins
1 large egg
2 large egg whites
½ cup apple butter
¼ cup oil (canola)
1 Tbsp vanilla
Topping: 2  Tbsp finely chopped nuts and 2 Tbsp toasted wheat germ
directions:
375 degree oven

Use muffin cups or grease muffin pan.  Stir dry ingredients together. Stir in carrots, apples, raisons.  Combine eggs, apple butter, oil and vanilla.  Add dry ingredients to egg mixture.  If too dry, add small amount of milk or apple juice to thin batter.  Put into muffin cups and top with topping mixture. Bake 15-20 minutes until done

title: Quiche
ingredients:
* 1 refrigerated pie crust
* 6 large eggs
* 3/4 cup half and half (any milk higher than 1% is best)
* 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
* 1/4 teaspoon pepper
* 1/4 teaspoon granulated onion powder
* 1 1/4 cups cooked ham, cubed
* 1 1/4 cups Mexican blend cheese, shredded
* 2 tablespoons green onion, diced
directions:
* Preheat oven to 350° Fahrenheit. Roll out the pie crust and shape it into a 9-inch pie dish. Set aside.
* In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, pepper, and onion powder.
* Whisk in 1 cup of shredded cheese.
* To assemble the quiche, place the cubed ham on top of the pie crust to fill the bottom of pan.
* Pour the egg mixture over the chopped ham.
* Sprinkle the remaining ¼ cup shredded cheese over the egg mixture. Garnish with diced green onion.
* Carefully place the pie in the preheated oven. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the quiche is cooked through.
* Remove from the oven and allow the quiche to sit for 5 minutes before enjoying it!
notes: Ham is in the original recipe but any protein can be used (we love bacon or sausage!) OR the vegetarian version can leave all meat out.

title: Homemade Granola
ingredients:
4 cups old-fashioned oatmeal
3 cups nuts - your choice (I mix sliced almonds, chopped walnuts and pecans)
1/4 cup coconut oil
3/4 cup real maple syrup
2 Tbsp Cinnamon
1/4 cup Raisins
1/4 cup Dried cranberries
1/4 cup Toasted unsweetened coconut
directions:
- Chop nuts, and combine with oatmeal.
- In a glass measuring cup, combine coconut oil, syrup, and cinnamon Microwave until coconut oil becomes liquid. Stir and pour over the oatmeal/nut mixture, until liquid covers all of it.
- Split mixture onto 2 large cookie sheets and bake for 18 minutes.
- Remove from oven, stir granola, and return to oven.
- Switch the cookie sheet to the bottom rack and the bottom one to the top rack. Bake for 15 min. more.
- Add raisins, dried cranberries, and toasted unsweetened coconut when cooled.
- Keep in a sealed bag or container.

title: Baked Oatmeal
ingredients:
2 large eggs
2/3 cup skim milk
1/4 cup light brown sugar
1/2 cup applesauce
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp cinnamon
2 cups rolled oats
2 large red-skinned apples, chopped
1 Tbsp butter
directions:
- Beat eggs and milk.
- Add brown sugar, applesauce, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and stir.
- Stir in oats, apples, fruits and nuts. Mix well.
- Spoon into a greased shallow, wide dish that has been sprayed with non-stick spray
- Add dabs of butter on top
- Bake for 25 minutes until hot / bubbly.
notes: l sprinkle some extra cinnamon on top before baking.

title: Lori's Apple Strudel
ingredients:
Dough:
2 cups flour
1 tsp salt
¾ cup Crisco
2 egg yolks
7-8 Tbsp water
Filling:
5 cups peeled, sliced golden delicious apples (or any other good cooking apple or combination)
¾ cup sugar
1 Tbsp flour
½ tsp cinnamon
1 Tbsp butter
Frosting:
½ cup confectioner’s sugar
½ tsp vanilla
1 Tbsp milk
directions:
- Mix flour and salt.
- Blend Crisco in with a pastry blender.
- Combine 2 egg yolks, slightly beaten and 7-8 Tbsp water together then add to dry mixture. Mix with a fork.
- Divide dough into 2 equal parts. Spray the pizza pan with Pam. Roll out 1 part of the dough onto a pastry sheet until slightly larger than the pizza pan. (It will be thin.)
- Turn over onto the pizza pan carefully and trim the edges to fit the pan.
- Mix filling except for the margarine and spread onto the crust. Dot the apple mixture with the margarine.
- Roll out the top crust with the remaining dough to be larger than the pan.
- Turn rolled-out dough onto the top of the apples. Fold edges under to seal and flute. Cut small slits on top of the entire crust with a knife to allow steam to escape.
- Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until lightly golden.
- While the strudel is baking, mix frosting.
- Remove strudel from the oven and drizzle frosting on top.

title: Yule B Sorry
ingredients:
- One can Frozen Lemonade Concentrate
- One empty Lemonade Can of Vodka
- One empty Lemonade Can of Cranberry Juice Cocktail
- Ice
directions:
- Place ingredients in blender
- Fill blender to the top with ice
- Blend and enjoy

title: Bourbon Slush
ingredients:
- 2 tea bags
- 1 cup of boiling water
- 1 cup of sugar. (If you double the recipe use 1 1/2 cups of sugar)
- 3 1/2 cups of water
- 1 6oz. (2/3 cup) can frozen orange juice concentrate, Thawed
- 1/2 6oz. (1/3 cup) can frozen lemonade concentrate, Thawed
- 1/2 cup Bourbon
directions:
Steep tea bags in 1 cup of boiling water for 2-3 minutes.
Add sugar to the tea, and stir until the sugar is dissolved.
Pour the tea and sugar mixture into a 2qt plastic freezer container.
Add the remaining ingredients to the freezer container and mix until well blended.
Place in the freezer for, at least, 10 minutes before serving.
If taking it in the sun for a longer period of time, serve in an insulated mug with a lid, and don't forget the straw!!
notes: Recipe makes about 6-7 cups

title: E2D2 Pimento Cheese Spread
ingredients:
1 cup shredded extra sharp cheddar cheese
1 cup shredded Pepper Jack cheese
8 oz of cream cheese
2/3 cup of real mayonnaise
4 oz can of pimentos and juice
2 Tbsp grated onion (or 1 tsp onion powder)
11/2 tsp black pepper
11/2 tsp granulated garlic
1 tsp cayenne pepper
directions:
Break up block of cream cheese, add mayo and the juice from the pimento jar and process in the food processor until relatively smooth.

Add all other ingredients to the smooth cream cheese/mayo/juice mix and and process until combined.

Enjoy on crackers or toast

title: Rusty Bucket Spinach Cheese Dip
ingredients:
1/2 shot glass white wine
2 teaspoon chicken base
1 lb velveeta cheese
Diced jalapeños (to taste)
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp cayenne pepper
1/2 cup Diced tomatoes
2 cups spinach pressed
2 oz 1/2 & 1/2
Salt & pepper to taste
directions:
Heat wine over medium heat with chicken base.

Add velveeta, garlic powder, onion powder & cayenne pepper.

When cheese is melted, add half & half, stir until smooth.

Remove from heat.

Add spinach, diced tomato, salt & pepper.

Serve w/ tortilla chips.

title: Queso Blanco
ingredients:
½ pound White American Cheese roughly chopped into 1" pieces
2 tablespoons chopped green chile frozen or canned will work fine (FYI -there are 12 Tbsp/can)
1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno slices diced fine
1 tablespoon juice from the pickled jalapenos
⅓ cup whole milk
¼ cup water
dash of cumin
directions:
Combine all ingredients in a medium size glass bowl.

Microwave for five minutes, pausing to stir after every minute.

The dip will be very watery at first, but it will thicken as it finishes cooking.

Serve hot, poured over just about anything that you want to make more delicious.

Enjoy!

title: Eddie Joe's Salsa
ingredients:
1 can of diced tomatoes
1 can of diced tomatoes with green chiles
1 small can of green chiles
Half an onion, diced
1 clove of garlic, diced
2 tablespoons of minced fresh cilantro
1 teaspoon of oregano
1 teaspoon of garlic salt
1 and a quarter teaspoon of cumin
A few drops of fresh lime juice

Optional:
Chopped pickled jalapeños to taste (5 or 6)
Red pepper flakes
directions: Throw everything in a food processor and pulse a few times.

title: Bridge Mix
ingredients:
3 cups Corn Chex™ cereal
3 cups Rice Chex™ cereal
3 cups Wheat Chex™ cereal
3 cups Cheerios™ cereal
3 cup pretzels sticks
2 cup peanuts
6 tablespoons butter or margarine
2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
1 teaspoons MSG (or Accent)
3/4 teaspoon garlic powder (more to taste)
directions:
Preheat your oven to 225 degrees F.
In a very large roaster, combine the cereals, nuts, and pretzels.
In microwave (or on stove) melt butter and mix in spices and Worcestershire. Pour over dry ingredients and stir gently to mix thoroughly.
Bake at 225 degrees for 2 hours, stirring gently with a spoon or shaking the pan every 30 minutes.
Cook for 2 hours. Let cool then pour into a brown paper grocery bag to drain overnight.

title: Garden of Eden Salad
ingredients:
10-12 cherry tomatoes, halved or quartered depending on size
1 yellow or orange bell pepper, seeded and
chopped
1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, and chopped
8 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/2-inch chunks
2 scallions, sliced thin
1/2 c. chopped fresh basil
1 t. salt
1/2 c. extra-virgin olive oil
2 T. red wine vinegar
1 garlic clove, minced
1/2 t. ground cumin
1/2 t. dried oregano
directions:
- Combine tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, cheese, scallions, basil, and salt in large bowl.
- Whisk oil, vinegar, garlic, cumin, and oregano in small bowl.
- Pour oil mixture over tomato mixture and toss to coat.
- Cover and let stand at room temperature 1 hour.
- Toss tomato mixture with cooked pasta and reserved pasta cooking water, if necessary.
- Serve and enjoy
notes: I often add more oil, vinegar and spices than the ingredients listed. My family also loves the seasoning blend, Spike, in all recipes, especially this one.

title: Fried Apples
ingredients:
* 1/2 cup unsalted butter
* 1/2 cup sugar
* 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
* 4 granny smith apples (peeled, cored and sliced)
directions:
* Add the butter to a large skillet on medium heat.
* Once melted whisk in the sugar and cinnamon.
* Add in the apples, stir and cook until softened, for 6 to 8 minutes.
notes: Usually made for holiday dinners and I have to triple the recipe.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
ingredients:
STEP 1
2 cups pretzels, chopped
¾ cup melted butter or margarine
3 Tbsp sugar
STEP 2
8 oz cream cheese
1 cup sugar
1 cup Cool Whip
STEP 3
Fresh strawberries, sliced
2 small or 1 large strawberry-flavored Jello
2 cups boiling water
directions:
STEP 1
Mix and put in a 13X9 pan.  Bake for 8 minutes at 400 degrees.  Cool completely.
STEP 2
Beat together and put on a cooled pretzel crust.
STEP 3
Put on the Cool Whip layer and chill.

title: White Chili
ingredients:
4 cups cooked turkey or chicken
1 lb. white beans (or 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed)
3 tablespoons olive oil
1 large onion, minced
3 garlic cloves, minced
8 oz. chopped green chilies (2 cans of 4 oz. chopped Mexican green chilies)
1 tablespoon fresh minced cilantro
1 tablespoon ground cumin
1 tablespoon dried oregano
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 pinch cayenne pepper
8 to 10 cups chicken broth
Salt and pepper to taste

OPTIONAL
3/4 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese
Salsa
Sour cream
directions:
Soak dried beans overnight.

In a large pot, sauté chopped onions in olive oil until soft and translucent (about 10 minutes).  Add beans, turkey (or chicken), garlic, chili's, cumin, oregano, cinnamon, cayenne and chicken broth.  Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer up to 2 hours.  If mixture seems too dry at any point, add additional broth.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Ladle chili into bowls and garnish with cheese, salsa, and sour cream, if desired.  Serve immediately.  Serves 6.

title: Easy Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
- Tablespoon Olive Oil
- One package of frozen mirepoix OR 1 carrot, 1 stalk of celery & 1 medium onion, diced
- 2 cans Costco Chicken or 3 cups cooked chicken,
- 4 to 6 cups of chicken broth (depends on how "soupy" you like it)
-Tablespoon Parsley
- Salt and Pepper to taste
- Cooked spaghetti noodles or rice
directions:
Heat oil and sauté mirepoix until softened.
Add chicken and heat until boiling, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add parsley and other seasoning to taste.
Serve over cooked noodles or rice.
notes: We use Better Than Bouillon Roasted Chicken Base for the stock. We like to add a small teaspoon of Huy Fong Foods Chili Garlic Sauce to our soup for a little kick. We don't add the noodles or rice to the soup directly because they get mushy when leftovers are saved.

title: Chili
ingredients:
INGREDIENTS
* 1 tablespoon olive oil
* 1 small onion diced
* 1 green bell pepper diced
* 2 garlic cloves minced
* 2 pounds lean ground beef
* 2 cups beef broth
* 1 8 ounce can tomato sauce
* 1 15 ounce can diced tomatoes, undrained
* 1 15 ounce can pinto beans
* 1 15 ounce can kidney beans
* 3 Tablespoons chili powder
* 1 Tablespoon oregano
* 1 teaspoon cumin
* 1 teaspoon coriander
* 1 teaspoon salt
* 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
directions:
* In a large pot add the olive oil over medium high heat. Add the onion, bell pepper and garlic and sauté until almost tender. Add in the ground beef and cook and crumble until brown.
* Add in the beef broth, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, pinto beans, kidney beans, chili powder, oregano, cumin, coriander, salt and cayenne.
* Bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer until it starts to thicken and flavors combine about 30 minutes.;*

title: Darcy's Potato Soup
ingredients:
3 cups of chopped potatoes (chopped small enough fit several on a spoon)
1 cup of water
1/2 cup celery slices
1/2 cup carrot slices
1/4 cup of chopped onions
1 teaspoon parsley flakes
1/2 teaspoon salt
Dash of pepper
1 1/2 cups of milk
2 tbsp flour
1/2 lbs chopped velveeta cheese
1 chicken bouillon cube
directions:
In 5qt pot combine potatoes, water, celery, carrots, onion, parsley flakes, bouillon cube and seasoning. Mix well.
Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Gradually add milk to flour, mixing until well blended, no lumps.
Add milk mixture to pot. Cook until thickened. Stir often.
Add velveeta cheese pieces and stir until melted.  Makes about 6 -8 servings.
Easily doubled.
notes: The perfect Lenten meal.

title: Max & Erma's Chicken Tortilla Soup
prep: 60 minutes - stove top 6 to 10 hours crockpot (prefered)
ingredients:
2 cans Campbell's Cream of Mushroom soup
2 cans Campbell's Cream of Chicken soup
2 cans Campbell's Cream of Celery soup
2 cans Campbell's Cheddar Cheese soup
2 (15 ounce) cans chicken broth
1 (15 ounce) can diced tomatoes
1 cup Pace medium picante salsa
1 (4.5 ounce) can Ortega green chiles
1 medium onion, chopped
4 cloves fresh garlic, minced
1 teaspoon red chile powder, more or less to your taste
Salt and pepper to your taste
1/4 cup fresh, chopped cilantro
4 cooked chicken breasts, cut into small chunks
1 package flour tortillas (optional)
1/2 pound longhorn style Colby cheese
directions:
For Crockpot: (Modified by Chris Deakin)
1. Add all ingredients to crock pot
2. Add chicken WITHOUT cooking
- if frozen cook low for 10 hours
- if fresh or thawed cook low for 6 hours
        - Also, cut into large pieces
3. At last 30 minutes
- remove chicken and shred
- return shredded chicken to pot
- Add cheese and cook for 30 more minutes

For Stove top: (original)
1. In a large stockpot combine and whisk together until smooth all eight cans of soup.
2. Add chicken broth.
3. Add tomatoes, salsa, green chiles, onion, garlic, chili powder, salt and pepper.
4. Bring all ingredients to a full boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 1 hour.
5. Add cilantro and chicken breast chunks. Simmer another hour.
6. While soup is simmering, make your soup toppings: Cut flour tortillas into small thin strips and deep fry in hot oil until lightly browned. Shred cheese.

To serve: Ladle soup into bowls, top with shredded cheese and fried tortilla strips.
notes:
Adjust chile powder to taste

If doubling this recipe must use a 12 quart stockpot.

title: Tortellini Soup
ingredients:
1 tbsp of olive oil
1-2 cloves of garlic
28 oz. diced tomatoes
1 block of frozen chopped spinach
1 qt. chicken/veggie stock
1 bag (36 oz.) frozen cheese tortellini
2 cups of water
Salt and Pepper to taste
Fresh Parmesan cheese to garnish
directions:
In a medium soup pot, start by sautéing your diced tomatoes in olive oil and garlic.
Bring to a simmer and add stock and water.  Put a lid on and bring to a boil.
Add in the block of spinach and stir to break up.  Put a lid on and return to boil.
Toss in tortellini and cook until tortellini is softened 5-7 minutes.
Serve. Top with fresh Parmesan cheese.

title: Bean & Ham Soup
ingredients:
ROUND ONE
3 quarts water (12 cups)
1 bag (2 cups) 13 kinds of beans
1 Tbsp salt
1 ham hock
¼ tsp summer savory
½ tsp basil
¼ tsp parsley
ROUND TWO
28oz. can diced tomatoes
2 cups chopped onion
2 cups chopped celery
2 cloves garlic – minced
ROUND THREE
½ lb. sliced smoked sausage
2-4 chicken breasts, boneless and chopped
directions:
- Add ROUND ONE ingredients into a large pot and simmer covered for 2.5 to 3 hours.
- Add ROUND TWO ingredients into the same large pot and cook uncovered for 1.5 hours.
- Add ROUND THREE ingredients into the same large pot and simmer uncovered for 40 minutes.

Serve and enjoy!

title: Stuffed Pepper Soup
ingredients:
3 tbsp olive oil
1 small yellow onion
1 green or red bell pepper*
1 yellow bell pepper*
1 large tomato
1 lb ground beef 85/15 recommended
3 cups beef stock
3 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried oregano
2 tsp dried basil
1 tsp garlic powder
1/4-1/2 tsp black pepper and salt to taste
3/4 rice of your choice
directions:
- Prepare rice as instructed on the package. You may want to start cooking rice after step 6.
- Dice all the vegetables first and set them aside.
- In a Dutch oven add 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Add ground beef, and cook just until brown.
- Break meat apart as it browns. Then drain off the fat. Reserve 1 tablespoon of fat in the pot.
- Add diced onions and bell peppers to the meat and cook until they start to soften. Mix in diced tomato.
- Cover the pot and let the meat and vegetables cook for a few more minutes.
- Mix in tomato taste and then, pour in beef stock. Add more stock if you like it more soupy.
- Season with oregano, basil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, mix well and lower the heat to low.
- Close the lid but leave a small crack for the heat to escape. Cook for about 20 minutes.
- Make rice in a separate pot. Remember rice will absorb soup broth.
- Portion rice in bowl to your liking (1/4 cup). Ladle soup over rice.
notes: Enjoy with Grilled Cheese sandwich.

title: Burbank Chicken
ingredients:
6 boneless skinless chicken thighs
Olive Oil
Salt and Pepper

Sauce
2 Tbsp Sesame Oil
3 Tbsp diced garlic
1/3 cup soy sauce
1 tablespoon brown sugar or honey
2 tsp rice wine vinegar
1/2 Tbsp chicken broth
1 teaspoon Huy Fong Foods Chili Garlic Sauce (or red pepper flakes)
1 teaspoon ground ginger
1 teaspoon ginger paste
directions:
- Season chicken with salt and pepper
- Fry seasoned thighs in olive oil until done then dice
- Add sesame oil and garlic into skillet and cook for 3 minutes.
- Add remaining sauce ingredients and cook for 1 minute.
- Add diced chicken, stir, lower heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
- Serve over cooked rice.
notes: Our version of Bourbon Chicken but with less sugar and more spicy heat.

title: Skinny Crispy-Coated Chicken
ingredients:
Nonstick cooking spray
1 cup finely crushed multigrain tortilla chips
1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed
1/4 teaspoon ground cumin
1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
1 egg
4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (about 1 1/4 lb)
Shredded romaine (optional)
Thick & chunky medium salsa (optional)
Avocado slices (optional)
directions:
Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a 15x10x1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray; set aside. In a shallow dish combine tortilla chips, oregano, cumin, and pepper. Place egg in another shallow dish; beat lightly. Dip chicken in beaten egg, then coat with tortilla chip mixture.

Arrange chicken in the prepared baking pan. Bake about 25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink (170°F). If desired, serve chicken on a bed of shredded romaine with salsa and avocado slices.

title: Grilled "Huli Huli" Chicken w/ Pineapple & Fried Rice
ingredients:
½ cup raw organic sugar
2/3 cup soy sauce or gluten free tamari
3 Tablespoons white wine
3 cloves garlic, chopped fine, or 3 teaspoons pre-chopped jarred garlic
1 teaspoon minced jarred ginger
3 stalks green onion, finely chopped

2 packages boneless chicken thighs

2 cups rice, white or brown
1 can pineapple rings (canned or fresh)
4 strips bacon, cut into pieces
¾ cup ham, cut into small cubes
1 egg
3 Tablespoons soy sauce or tamari (gluten-free, if desired)
3 stalks green onion, sliced
directions:
Prep work prior to the day of cooking:
- Mix the first six ingredients to make marinade.
- Add to a large, sealable plastic bag. Soak chicken overnight or at least 3-4 hours before grilling.

When ready to make dinner:
- Cook rice. Set aside.
- Saute bacon until crispy. Add ham and cook all together. Turn the heat to low.
- Mix egg with soy sauce or tamari.
- Grill on medium-high until chicken is done.
- Grill pineapple rings. Cover everything with foil until the rice is done.
- Add rice to the pan with bacon and ham. Add the soy sauce egg mixture to the rice and stir until it is mixed.
- Add in green onions and stir.
- Serve grilled Huli Huli chicken on top of o rice with grilled pineapple on top of the chicken.

title: Foil Pack Salsa Verde Chicken & Rice
ingredients:
- 1 cup Instant white rice
- 1 and 1/2 cups water
- 2 (7 ounces each) large boneless skinless chicken breasts
(Cut raw chicken breast into 1 in bite size pieces before putting in the foil)
- 1/2 teaspoon each: cumin, garlic powder, salt and pepper
- 1 teaspoon chili powder
- 1/8 teaspoon paprika optional
- 1 ounce full-fat cream cheese
- 6 tablespoons salsa verde
- 1/2 cup roasted corn
- 1/2 cup black beans
- 1/2 cup pepper jack cheese
- Optional: roasted green chiles lime, cilantro, sour cream, red bell pepper
directions:
- Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.
- Generously grease with cooking spray 2 large sheets of heavy-duty tin foil.
- Cut 2 chicken breasts into 1-inch bite-size pieces.(Optional: Pound the pieces to 1/2 inch thickness)
- Mix the instant rice and water and let stand for 5 minutes.
- In a bowl large enough for the 2 chicken breasts, toss together all of the seasonings: cumin, garlic powder, salt, pepper, chili powder, and paprika.
-  Add the chicken breast pieces and toss in spices until all is well coated. (Depending on the amount of chicken you may need to double the spices.)
- Divide the rice and water mixture evenly among the 2 foil packets.
- Place ½ of the seasoned chicken on top of rice in each foil packet.
- Slice the cream cheese into 4 equal pieces and place 2 pieces on top of the packet.
- Pour 3 tablespoons of salsa verde on top of each packet.
- Put 1/4 cup corn and 1/4 cup black beans next to each packet.  If desired add a few pieces of thinly sliced red pepper to packet.
- Seal the packet allowing for expansion and make sure it is 100% sealed.
- Bake for 30-50 minutes** or until the chicken is completely cooked through (registers 165 degrees F)
- When complete, dump the foil packet into a clean bowl and mix everything up to combine
- Put pepper jack cheese out on the side to top the serving with pepper jack cheese (We do this instead of putting cheese on the entire bowl as leftovers reheat better without cheese on it).
- Add other optional toppings as desired.
notes:
We have one that does not like beans so we make one packet with beans and one with double corn.
TO GRILL: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat and allow to heat for 10-15 minutes. Place completely sealed foil packets on grill for 25-35 minutes (or until chicken registers 165 degrees F) flipping once in between at about 10-15 minutes

title: Company Chicken
ingredients:
Half cup seasoned bread crumbs
Half package of spaghetti sauce mix
4-6 chicken breasts boneless/skinless.
Half package of fresh sliced mushrooms
1/2-3/4 cup white wine
1 tsp dried basil leaves
1 can chopped tomatoes.
directions:
Combine bread crumbs and spaghetti mix into a box and shake to mix.

Add chicken breasts, one at a time and shake to coat.

Place chicken in a square or rectangular baking dish.

Sprinkle remaining bread crumb mix over chicken in the baking dish.

Cover with wax paper and microwave on high for 6 minutes.

Rearrange chicken then pour wine over the chicken.

Add mushrooms and tomatoes then sprinkle with basil.

Cover with wax paper, return to microwave and cook at 70% power until done (6 to 9 minutes)

title: Eddie Joe's Version of Dolly Parton's Casserole
ingredients:
The Creamy Chicken & Mirepoix Base
- Cooked chicken: 3 to 4 cups, shredded or chopped (rotisserie chicken works perfectly)
- Mirepoix: Onion: 1/2 cup, finely diced (about half a medium onion), Carrots: 1/4 cup, finely diced (about 1 small carrot), Celery: 1/4 cup, finely diced (about 1 rib)
- Butter: 1 tablespoon (for sautéing the veggies)
- Cream soup: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
- Sour cream: 1 cup
- Chicken broth: 1/2 cup (reduced for layering)
- Seasonings: 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon onion powder, salt, and black pepper to taste

The Crunchy Topping Layers
- Stuffing mix: 1 box (6 oz) Stove Top stuffing mix (savory herb or chicken flavor)
- Chicken broth: 1/4 cup to 1/3 cup, warmed (for drizzling)
- Ritz crackers: 1 sleeve (about 1 cup crumbs), crushed
- Butter: 2 to 3 tablespoons, melted (to toss with the crackers)
directions:
1. Prep the Oven and Veggies
- Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
- Lightly grease a 9x13-inch glass or ceramic baking dish.
- Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a skillet over medium heat.
- Sauté the mirepoix (diced onion, carrots, and celery) for 5 to 7 minutes until they are softened and the onions are translucent.
- Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

2. Mix the Base
- In a large bowl, combine the shredded chicken, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, 1/2 cup of chicken broth, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and your cooked mirepoix. Stir until well combined.

3. Layer for Maximum Crunch
- Layer 1 (The Base): Spread the creamy chicken and vegetable mixture evenly along the bottom of your prepared 9x13 dish.
- Layer 2 (The Stuffing): Sprinkle the dry Stove Top stuffing mix evenly over the top of the chicken layer. Do not stir it into the wet base.
- The Target Drizzle: Gently drizzle 1/4 to 1/3 cup of warm broth in a thin stream directly over the dry stuffing granules to help them plump up while baking.
- Layer 3 (The Ritz Crust): In a small bowl, toss the crushed Ritz crackers with 2 to 3 tablespoons of melted butter. Scatter the buttery crumbs evenly over the stuffing layer.

4. Bake to Golden Perfection
- Cover the baking dish tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes to trap the steam and cook the stuffing through.
- Remove the foil and bake uncovered for an additional 10 to 15 minutes until the Ritz cracker topping is a beautiful golden brown and the edges are bubbling. (Optional: Broil for the final 1 to 2 minutes if you want an extra-shatteringly crisp crust, watching closely so it doesn't burn).

Let the casserole rest for 5 to 10 minutes before serving so the layers set into perfect, juicy portions.
notes: We use three cans of Kirkland Signature, Chicken Breast from Costco and 12 oz bag of Kroger Frozen Mirepoix. This recipe makes enough for three meals (6 portions): one to eat immediately, one to refrigerate for leftovers later in the week, and one to freeze.

title: Posole
ingredients:
1 Tbsp vegetable oil
2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2" chunks
1 medium white onion , chopped
4 garlic  cloves, minced
1 bottle (12 oz) Mexican beer
1 carrot , chopped
1 can (4 oz) chopped green chilies
1 can (15 oz) hominy, drained and rinsed
1 bunch cilantro, chopped
2 tsp cumin
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp salt
Red-pepper flakes to taste
4 lime wedges
4 soft corn tortillas
directions:
1. Heat a 4-to 6-quart pot on high and add the oil. Add the pork and let the pieces brown on all sides, 3 to 5 minutes. Add two-thirds of the onion and cook, stirring constantly, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the garlic and stir another 30 seconds.

2. Add the beer. After the foam subsides, add the carrot, chili's, half of the hominy, two-thirds of the cilantro, the oregano, the salt, and 4 cups of water.

3. Bring the chili to a boil, and then reduce to a simmer and cover. Cook until the pork is fork-tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Add more water if it looks too thick, and skim off any foam. During the last half hour of cooking, mash the remaining hominy and stir it into the stew.
notes: I will often add a second can of hominy to my posole.

title: Egg Roll in a Bowl
ingredients:
* 1 1/2 lb ground pork
* 1 large onion diced finely
* 16 oz  (i1bag) coleslaw mix
* 1/2 cup carrots peeled and finely shredded
* 1/2 tsp onion powder
* 1/2 tsp garlic powder
* 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
* 1 1/2 tsp ground ginger
* 1 tbsp garlic minced
* 1/2 to 3/4 cup soy sauce (I used a little over 1/2 cup)
* 2 tbsp sesame oil
* 2 tbsp vegetable oil
* green onion for garnish (optional)
directions:
* Cook ground pork in a large deep sided skillet over medium heat until no longer pink. Be careful to not break the ground beef into smaller pieces, keep the pieces larger.
* Drain grease and return to the stovetop. Add onions and minced garlic and cook until meat is browned, again, keep the ground beef in larger pieces.
* Add 2 tbsp sesame oil, carrots, and cabbage to the skillet. Use tongs to combine. Let cook for. about 5 minutes.
* In a small separate bowl combine onion powder, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, ground ginger, soy sauce, and vegetable oil. Pour over meat and cabbage mixture.
* Reduce heat and continue to cook for about 5 minutes.

title: Sunday Pasta & Sauce
ingredients:
1 half roll (.5 lb) Bob Evans Premium Pork Italian Sausage
1 jar Rao's Homemade Marinara Sauce
One teaspoon of Huy Fong Foods Chili Garlic Sauce (optional)
Your choice of pasta
directions:
- Brown half pound of Italian sausage in a pot
- Add marinara sauce and chili garlic sauce.
- Simmer 10 minutes while cooking pasta
- Serve over cooked pasta
notes: We love the sausage ravioli from Aldi as our pasta. The chili garlic sauce gives it a kick!

title: Creamy Mushroom & Bacon Gnocchi
ingredients:
1 Package Shelf stable gnocchi
2 tablespoon Butter
2 Cups Sliced mushrooms
2 Cloves Garlic minced
4 Slices Cooked bacon chopped
½ Cup Herb & garlic cream cheese
1 ½ Cups Milk
¼ Cup Fresh grated parmesan cheese
1 tablespoon Dried chives
Salt and pepper to taste
¼ Cup Fresh parsley chopped
directions:
- Bring a large pot of water to a boil
- In a large skillet, melt the butter on medium heat and add the mushrooms and garlic. Cook until mushrooms begin to soften and brown.
- Add the cooked bacon, then add the cream cheese. And stir until it's melted
- At this point, your water should be boiling. Add the gnocchi and cook for 1-2 minutes until the first few gnocchi begin to float to the surface.
- As soon as you've added the gnocchi to the boiling water, add the milk, chives, salt and pepper to the skillet with the mushrooms and bacon and stir to combine all the ingredients.
- Drain the gnocchi and add to the skillet. Stir to combine and add the parmesan cheese.
 - Heat for about 2 minutes until the sauce begins to thicken and the cheese is melted. It will continue to thicken after being removed from the heat.
- Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve.

title: Pepperoni Rolls
ingredients:
2 cups of warm liquid (1 ½ cups water, ½ cup milk)
¼ cup sugar
1 Tbsp yeast
8 cups of flour
2 eggs
1 Tbsp salt
1 stick butter (softened)
Sliced pepperoni
Grated cheese (cheddar and/or mozzarella)
directions:
- Make a “sponge” by combining 2 cups of flour, 1 ½ cups of warm liquid, yeast and sugar.  Let rise for 10-20 minutes.  Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Knead for 1-2 minutes.  Put in a greased bowl and turn over once.  Cover and let rise until double. Punch down and let rise again.
- Pinch off a small ball of dough and roll it flat with a rolling pin.  Layer slices of pepperoni on top and sprinkle with your choice of cheese ( cheddar or mozzarella).  Roll up and pinch to seal. You may need to dip your finger in some water and moisten where the dough needs to seal.
- Bake on a parchment-lined cookie sheet for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
notes:
- These are best enjoyed warm.  Can be frozen and reheated.
- Also, if you are in a hurry, the rolls can be made after the dough rises only once.
- Makes approx. 20 large pepperoni rolls or 30 smaller ones.
- 1 ½ times the recipe makes 30 large rolls.

title: Ma Deak's Hungarian Goulash
ingredients:
1 pound beef cut into cubes
2 medium onions minced
1/4 teaspoon dried mustard
1 1/4 teaspoon paprika
1 1/4 teaspoon salt
2 tablespoons brown sugar
3 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
3/4 teaspoon cider vinegar
6 tablespoons ketchup
3 tablespoons flour
directions:
* Brown meat on all sides in a heavy pan or a Dutch oven
* Add the onions, sauté until translucent
* Mix all other ingredients together and add meat and onions after it’s brown
* Simmer mixture for an hour and a half depending on the cut of meat
* When done dissolve 3 tablespoons of flour and a couple water and add to the meat
* Stir and cook until thickened
* Serve over rice or noodles

title: Pepper Steak
ingredients:
Ingredients:
1-2 lbs thinly sliced London Broil or ribeye or 2 cans of Costco canned beef
1 Tbsp water
1 Tbsp cooking wine
1 medium onion
2 small bell peppers
2 scallion whites
3 cloves garlic
1/2 tsp ginger paste
1 tsp sesame oil
Cooking oil for wok or pan

Sauce:
3/4 cup beef broth
1 Tbsp oyster sauce
2 Tbsp soy sauce
2 tsp sugar
1 tsp cracked black pepper
2 Tbsp cornstarch
directions:
1. If using beef cut into thin strips
2. Dice scallions, garlic, green peppers and onions then set aside.
3. Mix sauce ingredients into a glass or bowl, stirring until cornstarch is incorporated.
4. Add cooking oil to wok or pan and heat until smoke visible. Add beef and stir until brown then add cooking wine.
5. Add garlic, scallions and ginger paste and stir.
6. Add 1 tsp of sesame oil and stir. Cook for approximately 2-3 minutes
7. Add sauce and stir. Simmer until sauce reduces and thickens
8. Serve with rice or noodles.;
notes: We like Chinese cooking wine (called Shaoxing wine) for this recipe. We use a bag of frozen 3 Pepper and Onion Blend from Krogers instead of fresh peppers and onions to save time. We like to add a small teaspoon of Huy Fong Foods Chili Garlic Sauce to our Pepper Steak for a little kick. We add 4 cups of beef stock (from Better Than Bouillon Roasted Beef Base) to the dish to create a soup.

title: Meatloaf
ingredients:
1 envelope Lipton® Onion Soup Mix
2 Ibs. ground beef
2 eggs
3/4 cup water
½ cup ketchup
3/4 cup plain dry bread crumbs *
directions:
- Preheat oven to 350°.
- In large bowl, combine all ingredients.
- In a loaf pan, shape into loaf.
- Bake uncovered 1 hour or until done.
- Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
notes: I usually prepare half of the recipe for 2 people.  A mix of beef and pork is also good.

title: Asian Ground Beef Noodles
ingredients:
2 tablespoon oil
250g ground beef
2 tablespoon soy sauce
1 teaspoon grated ginger
2 teaspoon White pepper powder adjust to your liking
2 tablespoon corn flour also called Corn starch
2 tablespoon spring onion chopped
120 g vermicelli more or less for two
2 tablespoon Chinese dark vinegar optional
2 tablespoon Chinese chilli oil optional
directions:
- In a saucepan heat the oil and ground beef over medium heat. Break the meat apart. Cook until lightly browned.
- Add in the grated ginger and soy sauce, and stir fry for 10-15 seconds. Add 1 cup of water and white pepper powder. Put a lid on and simmer for 10 minutes. Add more water if it evaporates too much. (time to cook the noodles)
- Boil the noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water according to packet instructions until al dente. Remove; strain and set aside.
- Mix the corn flour with 1/2 cup of water and pour into the beef sauce. Stir until evenly thickening.
- Toss in the cooked noodles and then serve with spring onions on the top. Add the Chinese dark vinegar and chilli oil if desired.
notes: A handful of salted peanuts can be added to the ground beef while cooking (before completely brown). Udon noodles are often used with this recipe.

title: Jim's Steak & Spaghetti Restaurant Sauce
ingredients:
2 lbs ground chuck
1 large onion diced
1 (16 oz) can tomato sauce
1 (12 oz) can tomato paste
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon black pepper
2 teaspoon salt
1/4 cup sugar
1 tablespoon vinegar
3 tablespoons chili powder
2 bay leaves
28 ozs water (use empty tomato sauce and paste cans)
directions: Add all the ingredients into a large pot and stir. Simmer for three hours, stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaves and serve.,
notes: "SECRET" recipe! Trust the directions. Do not brown the meat. Pull it apart as you are adding to the pot.

title: Darcy's Sloppy Joes
ingredients:
2 lbs ground beef
1 onion diced
2 1/2 cups (20 oz bottle) ketchup
1 Tbsp of yellow mustard
1 Tbsp of apple cider vinegar
1/2 cups of water
2 Tbsp of sugar
1 Tsp salt
1 Tsp pepper
1/4 paprika
directions:
In a 4-5 qt pot brown ground beef and onion and drain grease.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Heat till hot.
Serve on hamburger bun.
notes: This is delicious!

title: Darcy's Enchiladas Acapulco
ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 -8oz can of tomato sauce
3/4 cup of green pepper (Sprinkle with Tabasco sauce for some spice)
1 -8 3/4 oz can kidney beans drained and rinsed
1/2 lb Velveeta Mexican cheese cubed
8 -6in tortillas
Olive oil or your choice of cooking oil
1/2 cup of chopped tomatoes
directions:
In large pan or 4 qt pot brown ground beef and drain.
Add tomato sauce, 1/2 cup green peppers.
Cook over medium heat 5 mins.  Stirring occasionally.
Add beans and 1/4 lb of cheese. Continue cooking and stirring until cheese is melted.
Add 1/4 cup mixture to tortilla, and roll up.
Spray 12x8 glass baking dish with Pam.
Place tortilla seam down in 12x8 glass baking dish.
Pour remaining meat mixture on top of tortillas.
Cover with foil. Bake at 350* for 20 minutes.
Uncover, sprinkle remaining cheese cubes over tortillas. Bake 5-8 minutes until cheese is melted.
Prior to serving sprinkle remaining green peppers and tomatoes.
Scoop two tortillas out per serving.
notes:
Makes four servings (2 enchiladas per serving).
This is Rich's birthday dinner every year!

title: Italian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients:
- 1 4 lbs. boneless beef sirloin or beef rump roast, cut into 2- to 3-inch pieces
- 1/2 cup water
- 1 envelope Italian dry salad dressing mix
- 2 teaspoons dried Italian seasoning, crushed
- 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red pepper
- 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
- 10 - 12 hoagie buns, kaiser rolls or other sandwich rolls, split
-  1 1/2 cups shredded Italian blend cheeses (6 ounces) (optional)
- Pickles, sliced onion, sliced pepperoncini and/or roasted red sweet pepper strips (optional)
directions:
1. Place beef in a 4- or 5-quart slow cooker. In a small bowl combine water, salad dressing mix, Italian seasoning, crushed red pepper and garlic powder; pour over beef in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 10 to 11 hours or on high-heat setting for 5 to 5-1/2 hours
2. Remove meat from cooker with a slotted spoon. Using two forks, shred the meat. Serve meat in rolls. If you like, sprinkle sandwiches with cheese and place sandwiches on two large baking sheets; broil sandwiches, one pan at a time, 4 to 5 inches from the heat for 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.
3. Strain cooking juices through a fine mesh sieve. Drizzle each sandwich with some of the strained juices to moisten. If you like, top each sandwich with pickles, chopped onion, pepperoncini and/or roasted red sweet pepper strips. Serve remaining cooking juices for dipping, if you like. Makes 10 to 12 sandwiches.
notes: This dish will make you want to split more firewood!

title: Braised Boneless Beef Short Ribs
ingredients:
3 ½ lbs. boneless short ribs, trimmed
Kosher salt and pepper
2 Tbsp. vegetable oil
2 large onions, sliced thin
1 Tbsp. tomato paste
6 garlic cloves, peeled
2 cups bold red wine, such as Cabernet Sauvignon
1 cup beef broth
4 large carrots, peeled and cut into 2-inch lengths
4 sprigs fresh thyme
1 bay leaf
¼ cup cold water
½ teaspoon cornstarch
directions:
1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat oven to 300 degrees.  Pat beef fry with paper towels and season with 2 tsp. salt and 1 tsp. pepper.  Heat 1 Tbsp. oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat until smoking.  Add half of beef and cook, without moving, until well browned, 4-6 minutes.  Turn beef over and continue to cook on the second side until well browned, 4-6 minutes longer, reducing heat if fat begins to smoke.  Transfer beef to a medium bowl. Repeat with remaining 1 Tbsp. oil and remaining meat.
2. Reduce heat to medium, add onions, and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and beginning to brown, 12-15 minutes.  (If onions begin to darken too quickly, add 1-2 Tbsp. water to the pot.)  Add tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, until it browns on the sides and bottom of the pan, about 2 minutes.  Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Increase heat to medium-high, add wine, and simmer, scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon to loosen browned bits, until reduced by half, 8-10 minutes.  Add broth, carrots, thyme, and bay leaf.  Add beef and any accumulated juices to the pot; cover and bring to a simmer.  Transfer pot to oven and cook, using tongs to turn meat twice during cooking, until fork slips easily in and out of meat, approximately 3 ½ hours.
3. Put water in a small bowl and sprinkle gelatin on top; let stand for at least 5 minutes.  Using tongs, transfer meat and carrots to the serving platter and tent with aluminum foil.  Strain cooking liquid through a fine mesh strainer into a fat separator or bowl, pressing on solids to extract as much liquid as possible; discard solids.  Let liquid settle for 5 minutes and strain off fat.  Return cooking liquid to Dutch oven and cook over medium heat until reduced to 1 cup, 5-10 minutes.  Remove from heat. Mix cornstarch and a few drops of water to form a slurry. Add slurry to mixture to thicken; season with salt and pepper to taste.  Pour sauce over meat and serve.
notes: Serve with buttered egg noodles, mashed potatoes, or roasted potatoes.   Enjoy!!

title: Shrimp Scampi
ingredients:
* 3 tablespoons butter
* 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
* 4 garlic cloves, minced
* ½ cup dry white wine or broth
* ¾ teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste
* ⅛ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste
* Freshly ground black pepper
* 1 ¾ pounds large or extra-large shrimp, shelled
* ⅓ cup chopped parsley
* Freshly squeezed juice of half a lemon
* Cooked pasta or crusty bread
directions:
- In a large skillet, melt butter with olive oil.
- Add garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
- Add wine or broth, salt, red pepper flakes and plenty of black pepper and bring to a simmer. Let wine reduce by half, about 2 minutes.
- Add shrimp and sauté until they just turn pink, 2 to 4 minutes depending upon their size.
- Stir in the parsley and lemon juice
- Serve over pasta or accompanied by crusty bread.

title: Air Fried Crab Egg Rolls
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon HOT SAUCE
1 Tablespoon Dijon mustard
1/2 tablespoon onion powder
1/2 tablespoon garlic powder
2 Tablespoons red bell pepper
1 Teaspoon old bay seasoning
1 Teaspoon Cajun seasoning
1/4 cup seasoned bread crumbs
2 eggs (separated)
1 Teaspoon chives (optional)
1 Tablespoon green onion
16 OZ. Crab meat (I use imitation crab!)
Egg roll wrappers (about 6)
directions:
1.  Preheat air fryer to 400* for 5 minutes.
2. Combine hot sauce, Dijon mustard, old bay seasoning, Cajun seasoning and one egg. Mix till combined.
3. In large bowl, add imitation crab, garlic powder, onion powder, red bell pepper, season breadcrumbs, chives, and green onion. Mix with wooden spoon. Mix sauce into mixture.
4. Crack 2nd egg into a bowl and mix it.
5. Lay egg roll wrap flat as a diamond. ♦ Spoon a cup or a little more of crab mixture in middle of wrap. Brush egg wash on 4 edges of wrap.  Pull each side to middle of mixture. Do not overlap. Pull bottom of wrap up and over mixture. Pull wrap together as you continue roll wrap up to the top to complete egg roll.
6. Complete all wraps. Hopefully there is enough mix for 6 egg rolls.
7. Spray each egg roll with veggie spray (Pam). Place egg rolls in fryer. Set timer for 8 minutes. Flip egg rolls about half way through.
notes: Top with Thai sweet chilli sauce or sauce of your choice.

title: Étouffée Sauce
ingredients:
- 4 tbsp butter
- 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup onion, finely chopped
- 1/2 cup celery, finely chopped
- 1/2 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 1/2 cups seafood stock (or chicken broth)
- 1/2 tsp Cajun seasoning
- 1/4 tsp smoked paprika
- 1/4 tsp dried thyme
- 1 bay leaf
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1/8 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)
- 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined (optional)
- 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
- 2 tbsp green onions, chopped
- 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped
- Juice of 1/2 lemon (optional)
directions:
1. In a saucepan, melt butter and whisk in flour to create a light brown roux (5–7 minutes).
2. Add onion, celery, and bell pepper. Cook 5 minutes, then stir in garlic.
3. Slowly whisk in stock. Add spices and bay leaf. Simmer 10–15 minutes.
4. Add shrimp (if using) and cook until done, 3–5 minutes.
5. Stir in Worcestershire, green onions, parsley, and lemon juice. Remove bay leaf.
notes: I serve this over grilled or broiled salmon. Good with just rice too.

title: Eddie Joe's Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients:
- 12 oz angel hair pasta, broken into thirds
- 2 (5 oz) cans tuna in water, drained and flaked
- 1 (10.5 oz) can cream of celery soup
- 3/4 cup half and half
- 1/2 cup mayonnaise (optional but adds richness)
- 3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
- 3/4 cup shredded smoked Gouda cheese
- 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
Topping:
- 5–6 Sky Flake crackers, crushed (about 3/4 cup)
- 2 tablespoons melted butter
directions:
- Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
- Cook angel hair pasta in salted boiling water until just al dente ~ 3 minutes
- Drain and return to the pot.
- In a separate pot while the pasta is cooking, mix together: Tuna, Cream of celery soup, Half and half, Mayo (if using), Garlic powder, onion powder, Salt and pepper, and
3/4 cup total cheese (half mozzarella, half smoked Gouda)
- Mix until combined, add the cooked pasta, then transfer to the baking dish and smooth the top.
- Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup mozzarella + 1/4 cup smoked Gouda over the top.
- Toss crushed Sky Flakes with melted butter and sprinkle evenly over the casserole.
- Bake uncovered for 25–30 minutes until hot and bubbling. Broil for 1–2 minutes at the end for a golden topping if desired.
- Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
notes:
- We like angel pasta!
- Elena is not a fan of mushrooms so Cream of Celery it is!
- Sour cream can be substituted for mayo.
- Elena brings home a lot of string cheese (Mozzarella) from work so it is used in this recipe, along with smoked Gouda, but cheddar cheese can  be substituted.
- Crushed Ritz crackers or potato chips can be used for the topping (but they're not as good as Sky Flake crackers!)

title: Parmesan Spinach Gnocchi
ingredients:
1 tablespoon olive oil
½ cup diced onion
⅛ teaspoon kosher salt
2 cloves garlic minced
½ teaspoon dried thyme
2 tablespoons unsalted butter ¼ stick
2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
1 cup whole milk
¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg
16 ounces dried gnocchi
½ cup grated Parmesan cheese
4 ounces fresh spinach
1 lemon juiced
directions:
- Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over medium-high heat. Keep it at a rolling boil until you're ready to cook the gnocchi.
- Heat a large high-sided skillet over medium heat. Add the olive oil and onion. Season with kosher salt and cook for 4-5 minutes or until the onion is soft and just beginning to brown.
- Add the garlic and thyme and cook for another minute.
- Add the butter and stir until it has completely melted. Sprinkle over the flour and stir until the mixture thickens and begins to bubble. Cook for an additional minute.
- Slowly add the milk, stirring constantly. If there are any large lumps of roux, whisk them until smooth.
- Bring the sauce to a bubble and cook just until it has thickened enough to coat the back of a spoon– about 5 minutes. Once the sauce has thickened, remove it from the heat and add the ground nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
- Add the gnocchi to the boiling water and cook for the time designated on the package– usually about 3 minutes.
- While the gnocchi cook, add the parmesan, spinach, and lemon juice to the cream sauce and stir to combine. The spinach may not fully wilt yet– that’s okay!
- Once the gnocchi rise to the top of the pot, they are ready! Scoop out the gnocchi (a spider strainer works best here) and add them to the spinach cream sauce. Toss to combine.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients:
- Sliced sourdough bread
- Swiss cheese
- White cheddar cheese
-Grated Parmesan cheese
- 1/2 sweet onion, sliced
- Tomato, sliced
- Butter, softened
- Pesto
directions:
1. In small skillet on medium heat, sweat down sliced onion in 1 tbsp of butter until caramelized.
2. Lightly spread butter on outside of slices of bread.
3. Place one slice of bread in cold frying pan butter side down. Spread tbsp of pesto on bread. Layer slice of Swiss cheese, cheddar cheese, and sprinkle shredded Parmesan cheese, caramelized onions and two slices of tomatoes. Put second piece of bread, butter side up, on top.
4. Turn on heat to medium high. Pay close attention to bread toasting on bottom and cheesecake melting. Carefully flip sandwich to toast other side of sandwich.
5. Cut diagonally.
notes: Makes 2 sandwiches.

title: Summer Spaghetti
ingredients:
- 4 large ripe garden tomatoes, cut into ½" cubes
- 1 pound Brie cheese, rind removed, torn into irregular pieces
- 1 cup, fresh basil leaves, cut into strips
- 3 cloves garlic, finely minced
- 1 cup + 1 Tbsp of extra virgin olive oil (EVOO)
- salt & pepper.
- 1/2 to 1 lb. linguine or spaghetti noodles
- freshly grated parmesan cheese
directions:
- Combine tomatoes, Brie, basil, garlic, 1 cup of EVOO, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper into a large bowl. Prepare at least 8 hours before serving and set aside,covered, at room temperature.
- Boil water, salt and cook pasta until desired doneness. (firm)
- Drain pasta and toss with tomato sauce.
- Serve at once, topped with Parmesan cheese,
notes: Good the days it's made. FABULOUS after it's been in the refrigerator for a day and the spices are absorbed into the noodles.

title: Eddie Joe's Chicken Marinade
ingredients:
2 tablespoons McCormick® Grill Mates® Montreal Chicken Seasoning
1/4 cup olive oil
4 tablespoons teriyaki sauce
2 pounds chicken breasts or thighs
directions:
Add ingredients into a large ziplock bag, shake and refrigerate for several hours.

Grill, fry or roast as you wish.
notes: I eyeball the ingredient portions when making the marinade so your tastes may vary.

title: Eddie Joe's Meat & Pork Marinade
ingredients:
2 tablespoons McCormick® Grill Mates® Montreal Steak Seasoning
1/4 cup olive oil
4 tablespoons teriyaki sauce
2 pounds beef or pork
directions:
Add ingredients into a large ziplock bag, shake and refrigerate for several hours.

Grill, fry or roast as you wish.
notes: I eyeball the ingredient portions when making the marinade so your tastes may vary.

title: Jiffy Mix Corn Casserole
ingredients:
1 box Jiffy Corn Muffin Mix (8.5 oz.)
1/2 cup melted butter
8 oz. sour cream
1 15.25 oz. can of regular kernel corn (drained)
1 15.25 oz. can of creamed corn
2 large eggs
directions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Put the eggs in a large mixing bowl and whip slightly with a fork.
Add melted butter, sour cream, and both cans of corn. Whisk together until well combined. Make sure to drain the whole kernel corn first.
Add Jiffy Corn Muffin mix. Stir until it's everything is completely mixed together.
Pour into buttered 8×8 inch casserole dish.
Bake for 45 minutes, uncovered.
When done, top will be golden and edges will be slightly cracked. Middle should be firm to the touch. (Not jiggly.)
notes: This recipe as written bakes in an 8×8 inch pan.

title: Elena's Pancit
ingredients:
8 ounces vermicelli rice noodles
1 cup chicken stock
3 tablespoons soy sauce
3 tablespoons dark soy sauce
3 tablespoons oyster sauce
1 tablespoon granulated sugar
3 tablespoons vegetable oil
1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs AND/OR pork, cut into bite-size pieces
Kosher salt
White or black pepper
1 small yellow onion, thinly sliced
2 medium carrots, scrubbed or peeled, thinly sliced into 3-inch-long sticks
3 cups shredded green cabbage (about 8 ounces)
4 garlic cloves, chopped
3 scallions, sliced in 2-inch pieces
Calamansi or lime wedges, for serving
directions:
Step 1 - Rehydrate the noodles: Place the noodles in a large, heat-proof bowl and cover with hot water. Using tongs, gently pry them apart. Soak the noodles according to package directions. (Be sure not to over-soak so they don't become mushy when stir-fried.) Drain.

Step 2 - In a medium bowl, combine the chicken stock, regular soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar. Set aside.

Step 3 - In a large wok or pan, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium. Add the chicken and/or pork, season well with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring frequently, until just cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the protein to a small bowl.

Step 4 - Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil to the wok. Increase heat to medium-high and add the onion, stirring frequently until it is fragrant and taking on a little color, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the carrots, cabbage and garlic. Stir-fry, tossing constantly, until the vegetables are crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Return the protein to the wok, stir-frying for 1 minute. Add the noodles and reserved chicken broth mixture; toss well. Cook, stirring frequently, until the noodles are coated and glossy from the sauce, about 3 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning, if needed. Stir in the scallions, remove from the heat, and serve with calamansi wedges for squeezing over the dish.
notes: We like snow peas in our pancit! We also use angel hair noodles occasionally.

title: Overnight Focaccia Bread
ingredients:
1 1# white bread flour
1 4/5 cup warm (slightly warmer than body temperature)
1 tsp instant yeast
1 tsp honey
1 Tbsp EVOO
2 tsp fine sea salt
directions:
DAY 1 (Dough Mixing Day)
- In a large bowl, stir together water yeast, honey, EVOO, and salt until evenly combined.
- Add the bread flour and mix until combined
- Place a cloth over the bowl and let rest for 10 minutes at room temperature
- Wet your hands and grab a handful of dough from the 12 o'clock position, pull up slightly (stretch), and pull it over the bulk of the dough to 6 o'clock.
- Repeat this action on all sides of the dough until it feels like you've created tension and you can't stretch the dough up and over anymore.
- It should tighten up into a rough ball. Let it rest for 10 minutes and repeat the stretch and fold action one more time.
- After the second set of stretch and folds, wet your hands then gather your dough and place its seam side down into the bowl so the top is smooth (this helps prevent air bubbles from escaping).
- Top the dough with a good drizzle of EVOO (1 tbsp) and rub it over the dough to make sure the entire top surface has been covered. Cover the bowl with a reusable shower cap, plastic wrap, or lid.
- Put in the coldest spot in the fridge for 24 to 48 hours.
DAY 2 (BAKING DAY)
- Prepare your 9 by 13-inch baking tray put a tiny bit of oil in the tray rub it all around then line with parchment paper top parchment paper with 1/2 3 tablespoons Of EVOO and spread it evenly on the base and side of the parchment.
- Remove dough from the fridge and using a curved dough scraper, gently release the dough from the side of the bowl and tip your dough onto your oil pan.
- Oil your hands and fold one side of the dough toward the middle of the BLOB of dough. Repeat with the other side (like folding paper into thirds) then flip the dough so the seams are on the bottom and the smooth side is on the top.
- Cover with another tray or plastic storage bag so the dough won't dry out.
- Let it sit for 1 1/2 2 1/2 hours (the dough should be mostly filling the space in the pan). if not oil your hands in from the underside of the dough, gently pull it towards the edge of the pan.
- Once you think the dough is ready (it will be fluffy and jiggly when you shake the tray), preheat the oven to 430 degrees.
- Drizzle the top with a little more EVOO and then oil your hands using both hands, press your fingers into the dough gently touching the bottom of the tray. Repeat until the entire tray of dough is dimpled (don't dimple too much Then lose the bubbles in the dough).
- Try not to pop the air pockets. Top with a sprinkle of flaky sea salt. Optional toppings include Rosemary (coated with EVOO), cherry tomatoes, onions, cheese, basil pesto, and chimichurri (add before dimpling).
- Bake for 18 to 22 minutes on the lowest rack. Remove when golden brown. Let cool in the pan just a couple of minutes then transfer to a baking rack which keeps the bottom crispy. Drizzle with just a touch of EVOO of after baking (but skip if topped with pesto or chimichurri).
- Serve and enjoy 1

title: Blueberry Zucchini Cake with Lemon Buttercream
ingredients:
CAKE
• 3 eggs, lightly beaten
• 1 cup, vegetable oil
• 3 teaspoons, vanilla extra
• 2 1/4 cups, white sugar
• 2 cups, finely shredded & drained zucchini
• 3 cups, all-purpose flour
• 1 teaspoon, salt
• 1 teaspoon, baking powder
• 1/4 teaspoon, baking soda
• 1 pint of fresh blueberries (save a few for garnish if desired)
LEMON BUTTERCREAM
• 1 cup butter, room temperature
• 3 1/2 cups, confectioners sugar
• 1 lemon, juice and zest (about 2 tablespoons)
• 1/8 teaspoon, salt
directions:
CAKE
- Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Prepare two 8-inch round cake pans.
- Grate a large zucchini {or two small zucchini) and place in a clean dish towel. Squeeze until most of the liquid comes out. You will want to have 2 total cups of shredded zucchini after it has been drained. Set aside.
- In a large bowl and using a hand mixer, beat together the eggs, oil, vanilla, and sugar. Fold in the zucchini.
- Slowly add in the flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda. Gently fold in the blueberries. Divide batter evenly between cake pans.
- Bake for 35-40 minutes in the preheated oven or until a knife inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean. Cool for 20 minutes in the pans then turn out onto wire racks to cool completely.
LEMON BUTTERCREAM
- Combine butter, sugar, and salt and beat together until well combined.
- Add lemon juice and vanilla and continue to beat for another 3 to 5 minutes or until creamy.
- Fold in zest (If you are piping this buttercream, I recommend leaving out the zest).

title: Nut Roll
ingredients:
Nut mixture:
3 egg whites
1 1/2 cup sugar
1 lb ground walnuts
1 tsp cinnamon

Dough:
1/2 lb. butter
3 egg yolks.
4 Tbsp sugar (1/4 cup)
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup warm milk
2 pkg dry yeast (4 1/4 tsp)
4 cups bread flour.
directions:
Nut Mixture:
1. Beat 3 egg whites until stiff.
2. Add 1½ cups sugar.
3. Beat until firm.
4. Fold in walnut and cinnamon (add a few drops of milk if too thick).
5. Divide into fourths

Dough:
1. Reserve a 1/2 cup of warm milk and about a tsp of sugar and mix with the dry yeast.
2. Let dissolve and set aside.
3. Beat the butter, egg yolks, remaining sugar, salt and remaining milk together.
4. Add the yeast mixture to the butter, egg yolk, sugar, salt and milk mix.
5. Add the flour and mix well (will be sticky).
6. Pat down with flour, cover and refrigerate overnight (or at least 6 hours).
7. Cut into 4 equal parts.
8. Tum out onto a lightly floured surface and roll into a rectangle.
9. Spread with nut mixture and then roll into nut roll' (10-12" long).
10. Set aside 2 hours.
11. Brush top with beaten egg white/ water mixture,
12. Bake at 375° for 20 min or so (until golden).

title: Italian Hangover Cake
ingredients:
For the Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 ½ teaspoons baking powder
½ teaspoon baking soda
½ teaspoon salt
1 cup granulated sugar
½ cup brown sugar
½ cup unsalted butter, softened
¼ cup vegetable oil
3 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 teaspoon almond extract (optional)
1 tablespoon orange zest
½ cup ricotta cheese or sour cream
½ cup buttermilk
¼ cup amaretto (or substitute with orange liqueur or bourbon)
½ cup chopped walnuts or pecans (optional)
For the Syrup:
¼ cup amaretto (or other liqueur)
¼ cup fresh orange juice
¼ cup granulated sugar
For the Glaze (Optional):
1 cup powdered sugar
2–3 tablespoons milk or orange juice
½ teaspoon vanilla extract
directions:
Preheat & Prep:
- Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
- Grease and flour a bundt pan or a 9-inch round cake pan.

Mix Dry Ingredients:
- In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

Cream Butter & Sugar:
-- In a separate large bowl, beat butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
- Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.
- Mix in vanilla extract, almond extract, and orange zest.

Incorporate Wet Ingredients:
- Mix in ricotta (or sour cream) and buttermilk until combined.
- Stir in amaretto.

Combine Wet & Dry Ingredients:
- Gradually mix in the dry ingredients until just combined.
- Fold in nuts if using.

Bake:
- Pour the batter into the prepared pan.
- Bake for 35–45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

Prepare the Syrup:
- While the cake bakes, heat the amaretto, orange juice, and sugar in a saucepan over low heat until the sugar dissolves.
- Let cool slightly.

Soak the Cake:
- Once the cake is out of the oven, poke small holes all over with a skewer.
- Slowly pour the syrup over the warm cake, allowing it to soak in.
- Let the cake cool completely before removing from the pan.

Make the Glaze (Optional):
- Whisk together powdered sugar, milk (or orange juice), and vanilla extract until smooth.
- Drizzle over the cooled cake.

Serve & Enjoy:
- Slice and enjoy with coffee or a little extra amaretto!
notes: This cake is even better the next day as the flavors meld together. Let me know if you want any modifications!
